events.title: More updates and fixes
events.summary: New Content:A stage on the christmas market where you can play music from your local filesystemA pet-able cat in the houseWearing hatsMore NPCs on the market, that even move around youFixes:Trees dont hover anymore, instead they grow from the ground like normal treesThe laterns doesnt shine through the lamp shade anymoreMarket items are placed better in the stalls When consuming items like eating and drinking, you see the actual itemsImproved wildlife modelsAnd smaller fixes

events.title: Adding details
events.summary: In this update I focused on two main things:Refine the interior of the players house to make it look more lived in and festive. This includes a christmas tree with presents, decorations, a chimney with stockings, set table, baking of cookies and moreChanged and added sound effects like the interactions with snow (throwing balls, place balls, falling and jumping in the snow) and othersFeedback is welcomed through any channelUpdates for the demo are coming till the release next month

events.title: Improvements and Bugfixes
events.summary: Updated the UI, especially the fonts to match the vibe of the game better.Dialogs are now better shown to the player.Added lots of sound effects for walking on different grounds and for actions.Added interactive notes to the loading screen.Added a santa hat as a collectibleAdded placed maps and wayfindersAdded NPCs walking around and fishingChanged design of ice blocks And a lot of bugfixes Further improvements are coming regularly

events.title: Demo out now!
events.summary: The first demo version of White Christmas is out now!The demo is singleplayer only, but the release will be multiplayer.So you can enjoy and discover the world on your own now, and share it with family and friends in the fully released game.I also plan to add a few more things to it like sleighing, gathering and cooking, and indoor minigames.Any suggestions and feedback is welcome, whether on Social Media, direct contact or in steams community hub. P.s.: Only two months till St. Nicholas Day~ Wi
